text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One early afternoon, as I was relaxing in my roomâ

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer...
There's something important I'd like to discuss...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Can we?! It's fine, right?!
Please say yes! Ready, go!
choice_data_list: Sure, but what do you want to talk about?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Actually, we have an interview scheduled for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: And there's a photoshoot scheduled for then, too, but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru said, 'If you take a photo, it'll suck
your soul away. I can't let myself be photographed!'

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "That's so true! When it goes *click*, your soul gets sucked right out with a *whoooosh*, leaving you totally zoned out!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You're fast on your feet, so you're fine, Suzuka-san,
but someone like me would get caught in an instant~

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It's just superstition...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Shut up!
Never let your guard down, that's what tripe stew is all about!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What if you let your guard down and they actually suck your soul right out~?! Oh, woe is me...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, is there anything we can do?
Any way to face down those reporters' giant cameras!?"
choice_data_list: Then just get your soul back.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Modern...? Does that mean it's safer compared to the old days?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I gave Matikanefukukitaru a brief explanation about the evolution of cameras.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see... So the mechanism is different
from those dreaded cursed daguerreotypes of old...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wow, I had no idea! You never cease to amaze, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Then we have nothing to fear!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*, Suzuka-san, are you listening?
There's no need to worry. Modern cameras—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um... I heard you, since I was right next to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru speaks proudly.
It seems she's become a bit wiser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What?! "Take back what was taken"?!
Is this Operation Get-Back?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, it's a bit risky, but it might work!
We'll pounce on them right when they're distracted sucking souls!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If I had left it alone, everyone in the country
would have had their souls sucked out and been left as empty husks, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: All right!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, Fukukitaru-chan. Ready!
Say cheese!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gwaaah, they took a photo of meee!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Still, it starts from here!
Like I'd let it be snatched away just like that~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Kieeeee, Get Baaack!
Soul Restoration Technique~!!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, wh-what's with that acting?!
It's hilarious, want me to take another pic?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was desperately channeling psychic energy into the camera.
I should probably redirect this energy toward something else.
